generation.reason: Grid modules need exact size, joins, pivots, and collision alignment.

styleReference.use: weathered industrial sci-fi proportions, layered rails, reinforced posts, and muted teal/rust accents
styleReference.licenceStatus: reference only; do not use as a runtime texture or claim as original source art

joining.straightRuns: Adjacent cells hide their shared end caps so the rail and base read as one continuous barricade.
joining.junctions: The presenter adds a perpendicular core for cross or T layouts; a future dedicated corner/end kit may replace this overlap.

budgets.texturePolicy: procedural vertex/material colour only for the functional prototype; use a small shared PBR atlas for final art

rejectionCriteria: does not fill exactly one simulation cell
pivot or ground contact causes placement drift
inner caps remain visible in a two-wall straight run
runtime uses the reference photo as a texture
model has no semantic nodes for runtime joining
